within_source: center both frozen scaled features and outcome within each original discovery facility; ridge alpha=1; no intercept; retain day weights
local_response: one unconstrained scalar per facility/model minimizing 2024 absolute error around the 2024 observed mean; weighted-median solution; smallest minimizer; zero if no response variation
strata: 2024 facility-equal weighted tertiles of temperature and load, crossed into 9 cells; fixed 2025 calendar quarters
aggregation: days within facility, then equal facilities
intervals: no new interval calibration or width changes
source_basis_and_scaling: original serialized specification, no future fitting
